On Friday, soldiers detained four foreign nationals near Kfar Tapuach. Police questioned them at Ariel station on suspicion of public-order offenses and entering a closed military zone, then passed their files to the Population and Immigration Authority for hearings before possible deportation. 

A military zone is a flexible device: it can keep outsiders from a confrontation, or keep witnesses from watching it happen. 

Meanwhile, Palestinian media reported that settlers entered al-Samou, south of Hebron, burned a Palestinian-owned vehicle, spray-painted graffiti on a home and damaged property. 

Footage cited by Israeli reporting showed the words “Nova revenge,” referring to the October 7 music-festival massacre. 

The raid gets a security label. The journalist gets a terrorist label. The foreign observer gets an expulsion hearing. The arson gets a report and a photograph. 

By sunrise, the territory has been made orderly again.

🔔 South Korea targets November review for second stage crypto legislation 

🌐 South Korea’s Financial Services Commission has set November for a National Assembly subcommittee review of the Digital Asset Framework Act, rejecting claims that work on the country’s second stage crypto legislation has been delayed. According to Seo Na yoon, head of the FSC’s virtual asset division, the regulator and lawmakers are moving in the same direction on legislation covering digital asset issuance and distribution, including stablecoins. Speaking at a National Assembly seminar in Seoul on Sept. 22, Seo said differences remain over when the government will submit its draft, but the November review remains part of the planned timetable. 

⚡️ “The FSC is not dragging its feet at all. We share the same view,” Seo said, responding to criticism over the pace of the legislation. “The direction has already been set, and while detailed discussions may be necessary in the process, there is certainly no intention on the FSC’s part to delay.”

🔗 Seo said the regulator wants the legislation passed quickly and expects discussions to proceed using bills that lawmakers have already introduced alongside the government’s proposal. Ten digital asset and stablecoin bills are currently pending in the National Assembly, giving lawmakers existing proposals to work from before the government completes its version.

📌 WHAT ARE TRADING EXIT CYCLES?

When funds are allocated to AI Trading, they are actively involved in the trading process.

Because of this, removing capital from trading is handled through trading exit cycles.

The system offers several options depending on the selected exit timeframe.

Trading exit options:

Fastest exit option
10% commission

2 days
5% commission

4 days
3% commission

6 days
2% commission

10 days
0% commission

The principle is simple:

Faster exit option = higher commission
Longer exit period = lower commission

Why?

The more time the system has to complete the trading exit, the lower the commission for removing funds from active trading.

What does “Instant Withdrawal” mean in the Trading Wallet?

You may currently see the fastest option displayed as Instant Withdrawal with a 10% commission.

This is the fastest available trading exit option, but it should not be understood as a guaranteed instant withdrawal.

Processing still requires time and is not guaranteed to be immediate.

It also does not mean that funds will instantly arrive in your external crypto wallet.

After the trading exit is completed, the funds first become available for withdrawal.

Only then can you submit a separate withdrawal request to your external wallet.
